messages:
dylan: quick idea: add 'tracelets' to onboarding. tiny deterministic traces that exercise tokenization, kv-cache rotation, and attention edgecases. cheap and fast.
riya: how are tracelets different from golden samples or mini-bench?
kevin: golden samples validate semantics, mini-bench measures perf on longer inputs. tracelets are unit-like sequences for runtime behavior: token boundaries, kv alignment, micro-latency spots.
sarah: good for catching kv-cache evictions, off-by-one tokenization, and small numeric drift.
dylan: intended to run at admit time, on canary, and during runtime/kernel upgrades. helps isolate runtime vs model-weight regressions.
matt: propose adding tracelets to model manifest. each model ships zero or more.
kevin: example manifest snippet idea: `"tracelets": [{"id":"kv-rotate-16","seq":["Hello"," world","\nexpand"],"asserts":["tokens-aligned","kv-checksum"],"max_latency_ms":50,"verified":"unverified"}]`
riya: restrict asserts to structural checks and small numeric checks, avoid brittle full-text equality.
sarah: trust boundary: unverified tracelets from third parties should only run in isolated smokehouse or slowpath. manifest field verified|unverified.
dylan: default unverified. verified tracelets can run in fast admit path and canary.
bench-bot: queued run for model foo/v2 tracelets on canary pool in ~10m.
matt: where do we store results for quick diffs? console needs compact summaries.
kevin: store a tiny run summary in the registry per run: pass/fail, p50/p99 latency, kv-checksum; full logs retained 7d.
riya: rollout semantics: admit-run (fast), continuous canary checks (cheap), and upgrade gating on Dedicated.
sarah: tradeoffs: noise from flaky asserts, false positives.
dylan: mitigation: assertion confidence levels + re-run threshold (default n=3) before alerting.
matt: add `runtest tracelet <model> --local` CLI for repro.
kevin: integrate with smokehouse runner to reuse infra. minimal infra delta.
riya: blockers: manifest schema change, lightweight verifier, onboarding docs, console UX for diffs.
dylan: i'll write a short RFC follow-up outlining manifest schema, allowed asserts, run semantics, storage policy, and mitigation strategy. aiming to post by EOD.
sarah: also add an emergency fallback: if a verified tracelet fails on canary, auto-fallback to previous runtime/kernel variant until triage.
dylan: noted. bench-bot, please post results in-thread when run completes.
bench-bot: run started; will post a compact summary in this thread when finished.
